items.title: De De Pierce Interview, 1960-01-10
items.q: Black and Burnell, the only two once they played out... In fact the whole family. They were just like the village people. All the sisters played, sisters, brothers, they all played.

ctx.x: Burnell Sonniac. All of them played, but I mean they never played much out.
Black and Burnell, the only two once they played out. And the girls too. In fact the whole family. They were just like the village people. All the sisters played, sisters, brothers, they all played.
I mean, they played jobs out.
